segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create the predicate for the data. let heartRate = HKQuantityType(.heartRate) let objectPredicate = HKQuery.predicateForObject(with: myHeartRateSample.uuid) let predicate = HKSamplePredicate.quantitySample(type: heartRate, predicate: objectPredicate) // Create the source descriptor. let seriesDescriptor = HKQuantitySeriesSampleQueryDescriptor(predicate: predicate, options: .orderByQuantitySampleStartDate) // Get the AsyncSequence that returns the individual data entries. let series = seriesDescriptor.results(for: store) // Access each data entry in the series for try await entry in series { // Process results here. let steps = entry.quantity.doubleValue(for: .count()) print(steps) } ```
